If at the end of your work, you are to be given a spreadsheet or a report for your client, confirm that there are separate download limits. Check the billing and renewal terms at checkout before you order.

What can you do with Ahrefs on the SEOGBTools?

Below you will see how to use Ahrefs reports to complete two standard tasks. Before planning work around them, make sure to know which reports are included in your SEOGBTools package.

Use keywords to create a new page.

If you purchased Keywords Explorer, begin by two or three keywords that describe the page you're trying to build. Examine keywords estimated search volume and Keyword Difficulty and then check the pages showing for each keyphrase. The outcomes can enable you to choose if visitors are looking for a product listing, comparison or guide.

Say you have a "buying" query and a "setup" query in your Product Page list. The buying query can trigger offers and package pages, which can then lead to the main topic. If the set up query gives you tutorials, go through those and review the answers that buyers ask after they understand the offer. You can reply to the product setup question on the product page and have a longer walk-through of its own page.

Complete with one main topic, a brief list of questions the page should answer, and any topics which you are saving for content later. That will allow the writer to have a short time to use and will keep the research narrowed down to decisions that will impact the page.

Look for competitor backlinks to review for outreach

If the package has Site Explorer and Referring Domains, then select a competitive page which has a target audience which is similar to yours. Check out the sites that connect to it, and look at the surrounding text that accompanies each link. A publisher might have referenced an example, original source or explanation that readers needed. This context can enable you to make the decision if your own page would be relevant for the same audience.

If relevant, note the name of the site where the outreach was handled, the page where the link is found, and why it may be beneficial to the readers of the site. You can use a few appropriate sources in a focused campaign. For larger lists for deduplication, filtering or reporting to clients, make sure the report can be downloaded and find out before subscribing if there is a row limit.

How to gain access to Ahrefs on SEOGBTools.

1. Click on the month Ahrefs offer. Take a look at the price and full payment in the purchase option on the product page.

2. Check WhatsApp and email. Access will be enabled immediately following payment and the setup instructions will be sent by SEOGBTools along those lines.

3. Open Google Chrome and follow the instructions on the extension. SEOGBTools keeps the underlying Ahrefs login credentials private.

4. Open the report on which you have been granted access to. Begin with a keyword or competitor page from your shortlist to ensure that your primary workflow is available.

In case you are ordering for a deadline, you should have Chrome available and set up to get orders at the WhatsApp number and e-mail address you've provided.

Support and Access Issues

If Ahrefs does not open after installation, please reach out to SEOGBTools support with the details of your order. Describe the point at which the process failed and give the error message if you noticed one. For instance, if you were given the instructions but failed to set up the extension, or if you had set up the extension, but Ahrefs would not open. That leaves a direction for support to explore.

In the event that the access doesn’t work, you may get a reimbursement or select another device from the SEOGBTools list to utilize in its place. Call customer service and provide your order information to make your request.

Ahrefs Group Buy FAQs

Do you have any exporting options for Ahrefs reports?

Please ask SEOGBTools what report you are interested in downloading. If you need a CSV to reach out to referring domains, ensure that the report allows for it, the number of rows you can download, and whether it exports credits or not.

Is it possible to save projects or get back to previous results?

Verify if your package includes saved projects and who can access them, even if you renew the package, you can still reopen projects that were saved. When working with client sites, review the current project and its visibility before adding a domain or saving research in a shared workspace.

Is there Site Audit and Rank Tracker available?

Request that SEOGBTools validates each feature. When using Site Audit, verify that you can add a website, how many pages you can crawl, and if you can conduct another audit. When it comes to Rank Tracker, see how many keywords can be tracked, and if it will allow you to retain the history you need to run repeating reports.

Which one is better Ahrefs or Semrush?

Begin with the task that you do the most. Compare referring domain reports and export options in the case of back links outreach. With regard to content planning, analyse keyword reports and look-up allowances. If the project is recurrent, review access to the project and if the results can be revisited. Check out the SEOGBTools Semrush Group Buy page, or shop for SEO tools.
